name: Diesel Fuel Conditioner

features.text: Formulated for all diesel fuel systems, including high pressure common-rail designs.
corrects problems that cause restricted spray patterns, poor fuel atomization, incomplete combustion and excessive emissions.
Adds lubricity to reduce fuel-pump & injector wear caused by ULSD fuel.
Raises the cetane number of diesel fuel for maximum horsepower, increased fuel economy and improved starting ability.

description: An advanced formula that removes deposits from fuel injectors, increases cetane levels and lubricates to restore horsepower, performance and fuel economy. It is designed to clean all types of heavy-and light-duty, off-road and marine diesel engines, including modern high-pressure common-rail designs. Excellent for use with ultra-lowsulfur diesel fuel (ULSD). Compatible with biodiesel and all types of exhaust emission systems, including diesel particulate filter (DPFs).
application: Add contents to the fuel tank at time of fill up. One 12 ounce bottle treats up to 20 gallons of fuel. For tools, equipment or recreational vehicles with 2 or 4 cycle engines, add ½ to 1 ounce of product per gallon of fuel.
